deadline.value: January 1 for admission and financial consideration; late applications considered through March 15 if positions remain. Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply for full consideration (for admission and financial assistance) is January 1 each year.

also.quote: Students are only admitted to the PhD program in the fall semester of each year.

fee_waiver.value: A few waivers exist, mainly for US citizens and permanent residents; none for international students.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers for international students cannot be granted.

gre_general.value: Not required; you may submit scores, and omission is not penalised.
gre_general.quote: the omission of GRE test scores will not adversely impact your application.

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics subject score may be submitted, especially for pure mathematics, but is not required.
gre_subject.quote: In this case you may submit the test scores, especially the mathematics subject test score if you are interested in pure mathematics areas

supervisor.value: The department does not say whether a supervisor is needed; applicants name potential advisors in the personal statement.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD applicant is offered a teaching assistantship with stipend (about USD 27,000 a year), tuition waiver and health insurance.
funding.quote: All applicants admitted to the PhD program are offered a teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree is not required to apply for the doctoral (Ph.D.) program.

notes: Probability and statistics is a research area within the mathematics PhD; there is no separate statistics PhD. The department does not waive the university English requirement.
